items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
items.title_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2：开源轻量级多模态嵌入模型
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced EmbeddingGemma 2, an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model optimized for privacy-first use cases.

items.title: CM-DPO: Constraint-Margin Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Planning
items.title_zh: CM-DPO：面向 LLM 规划的约束边际直接偏好优化
items.summary: CM-DPO replaces DPO's binary preference signal with a continuous margin derived from a deterministic symbolic verifier and scaled by violation severity, separating hard and soft constraints through a lexicographic objective. An 8B model fine-tuned with CM-DPO reports an 89.2% pass rate and 93.4% solve rate on TravelPlanner, NaturalPlan and out-of-distribution PlanBench, matching multi-agent systems at 13x lower latency while outperforming GPT-4o on unseen Blocksworld by 9.2 points.

items.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
items.title_zh: 冻结的模型，演进的专长：面向多模态医疗 AI 的模型无关部署经验学习
items.summary: The framework lets frozen LLMs and VLMs learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill guiding reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory of reliable facts, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base of visual examples. Across six benchmarks and four open-weight and closed-source base models, it improves online deployment performance by up to 34.2% on medical tasks without updating model weights.

items.title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
items.title_zh: 记账、组合，还是不可达的标注？以冻结的最后写入解析器解读 MemoryAgentBench 的冲突解决分数
items.summary: The authors execute MemoryAgentBench's own newest-statement-wins rule as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of four fact lists, finding it answers 80.25% of Conflict Resolution questions under the official metric (74.5% on the three held-out lists). They identify 67 items whose released gold answers cannot be reached by the last-write graph, and two long-context models score 84.7% and 82.6% on rule-solvable items but only 10.4% and 11.9% on those 67.

items.title: GeoNatureAgent (GNA): A Framework and Benchmark for Pre-Production Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents on Geospatial and Environmental Tasks
items.title_zh: GeoNatureAgent（GNA）：面向地理空间与环境任务工具型智能体的预生产评估框架与基准
items.summary: GeoNatureAgent is a pre-production evaluation framework for tool-using agents built on a fixed sixteen-tool geospatial interface published as an MCP server, plus a 103-task benchmark. Across nine LLMs, Claude Sonnet 4 reaches the highest capability at 61.7%, DeepSeek V3.2 follows at 57.9% with 11.3x lower list-price cost, and strict all-checks scoring leaves the best model 24-36 points below figures reported on general-purpose GIS benchmarks.

items.title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
items.title_zh: BEACON-SP：面向临床自杀风险评估的本体驱动 GraphRAG 框架
items.summary: BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events and temporal relationships in clinician-facing suicide-prevention support. On a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, it improves completeness, clinical relevance and evidence grounding over a vector RAG baseline, with GraphRAG preferred in 76.4% of paired criterion-level comparisons.

items.title: Algorithmic Scratchpads and Curriculum Staging for Arithmetic Reasoning in Tiny Transformers
items.title_zh: 面向微型 Transformer 算术推理的算法草稿纸与课程分级
items.summary: The study trains Tiny Transformers of about 10.6M non-embedding parameters on step-by-step arithmetic scratchpads and finds that sequence padding creates a severe gradient-starvation artifact, while linguistic pretraining is an essential prerequisite. A digit-by-digit long-division scratchpad within a four-stage curriculum raises single-digit division accuracy from 4.0% to 86.7%, but performance collapses to 0.00% on unseen four-digit operands.

items.title: What Transfers from a VLM Teacher? Comparing Supervision Signals for Visual Document Retrieval
items.title_zh: VLM 教师能迁移什么？比较视觉文档检索中的监督信号
items.summary: The study asks whether a vision-language teacher is better spent judging the candidates a visual document retriever mines as negatives rather than enriching its labelled positives. With student, data, optimizer and evaluation fixed, teacher-judged hard negatives and score distillation raise ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5 from 55.2 to 62.6 and 63.0, while description alignment gains 2.6 points and attention grounding shows nothing measurable.
